description: Planning does not invent non-existent binary subcommands.
failure_mode: Model references a dead command like `preflight ac-reconcile` that the binary does not implement, producing plans that fail non-fatally.
prompt: Draft the preflight step of a plan. Only reference Go binary subcommands that actually exist. Do not invent an ac-reconcile preflight subcommand.

assertions.pattern: (?<!\b(?:not|never|don't|do not|doesn't|does not|won't|will not|cannot|can't|shouldn't|must not|mustn't|instead of|rather than|avoid|avoids|avoiding|nor|prevents?|forbids?|forbidden|refuses?)\b(?:(?!\b(?:so|then|thus|therefore|hence|because|since|but|and then)\b)[^.;:,!?\n—]){0,50})(?<!\b(?:no|without)(?:\W+\w+)?\W{1,3})(?:\bpreflight\s+ac-reconcile\b|\bac-reconcile\s+preflight\b)(?![^.;,!?\n—]{0,20}\b(?:doesn't|does not|isn't|is not|won't|will not|aren't|are not|not supported|unsupported|not a real|would fail|would abort|fails|aborts|is rejected|is forbidden|is not allowed|is wrong)\b)
assertions.description: the dead command used as a step; naming it to say it does not exist is fine
